## Cursor implementation kickoff — VEL-IMP-001

**Owner requested implementation in Cursor** on 2026-10-11 after explicitly allowing noncritical Figma UI polishing to be deferred. This is a first **bounded local-development slice**, not global G_DESIGN/G_CODE state clearance for all MVP tasks.

### Prepared handoff (code execution is NEXT, not claimed complete)
- `docs/agent-workflow/tasks/VEL-TASK-0004.yaml`: explicit scope, denylist, evidence gaps, owner-directed bounded authorization, acceptance.
- `docs/plans/VEL-IMP-001-CURSOR-KICKOFF-2026-10-11.md`: inspected existing web/api structure, exact pasteable Cursor Agent instructions, test plan, local bootstrap, report contract.
- Tracking [Issue #58](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/issues/58).

### Implementation target
- Preserve the existing Next16/Nest11/Supabase book flow; no project regeneration.
- Correct Library status semantics and conditional empty/populated rendering, account transition state and delayed response leakage.
- Test with two disposable local accounts against existing bearer and RLS protections.
- `pnpm check`, `pnpm build`, focused tests; record real outputs in Cursor's ExecutionBundle.

### Exclusions / approvals
No schema migration, chapter editor/revisions, BYOK AI, real manuscripts, production secrets, paid services, deployment, or public pilot. Residual signed-out unexpired JWT/direct PostgREST access remains documented and unremediated for actual private author data. Figma master [original file](https://www.figma.com/design/krXupCfSLUnOQxEOjIlp9U); separately reviewed [PR #57](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/57) was unmerged at kickoff.

**Do not merge this PR until Cursor actually implements the changes, produces test evidence and owner reviews the code.** Current branch contains the task/handoff documents only; runtime implementation has not yet been run.

## Full implementation roadmap
A full M1–M8 Cursor roadmap with Stage 0–12 work packages, VEL-IMP-001..008 sequence, eleven author journeys, per-feature acceptance checks, security, restore, author testing and separate private-pilot/release gates has been added at docs/plans/MVP-END-TO-END-IMPLEMENTATION-ROADMAP-2026-10-11.md. It is proposed, not blanket approval for later implementation slices. The current task remains only VEL-IMP-001.


## PAUSED — newer owner instruction (2026-10-11)
The owner reset the implementation workflow to **planning only**: complete the full M1–M8 roadmap and review it before opening/configuring Cursor Desktop; **no application coding or Cursor Agent execution yet**. This prior kickoff is **not currently executable**. See [new planning-only PR #60](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/60), containing the master roadmap and future Cursor Desktop checklist. Preserve this branch as historical preparatory context; do not merge, run the old agent prompt, or infer G_CODE approval. A fresh bounded task will be selected after the new plan and desktop baseline are reviewed.
title: PAUSED — prior Cursor Library kickoff (superseded by planning reset)
